note: Annotations are one question per item. For the drive set, 'end' is the moment in the video when the question is asked (the model sees frames up to it); the timeline shows the question and its answer both at 'end', and box coordinates are normalised [x1, y1, x2, y2]. The general event items have no 'end' and ask for all steps at once, so the question is placed at t=0 and the steps come from parsing the answer text. No clip: the driving videos sit in gated Kefan22 HF repos that our token could not open (HTTP 403), and the COIN video is YouTube-only.
